# Jev vs LLM judge: benchmark brief

- App version recorded with the run: v1.31.1-202609272108
- Run completed: 2026-09-27T13:15:17.080Z
- Brief generated: 2026-09-27T13:15:24.099Z by current app vX-CHANGED-AFTER-RUN (export version; may differ from the recorded version above)
- Rows in the run: 7 (frozen when the run started; later dataset edits are not included)
- LLM judge: Foundry built-in LLM judge (gpt-5.4-mini, host-paid, capped)
- Pass threshold for agreement: score ≥ 3

## Same-workload comparison

Scope: **same workload (all rows matched)**. A row is compared only when both judges scored exactly the same metrics and cost and time were recorded for both.

- Compared rows: **7 of 7**, covering 21 metric evaluations per judge
- Excluded rows: 0 (none)
- Estimated cost on the compared rows: Jev $0.00033, LLM judge $0.035
- Same-workload cost ratio (LLM judge ÷ Jev): **107×**
- Projected: Jev $0.047 vs LLM judge $5.004 per 1,000 rows (from the compared rows)
- Time per compared row (median): Jev 305 ms (one call scores all metrics of the row); LLM judge 25.35 s (sum of its per-metric call times; calls run in parallel, so actual wait per row is lower and was not measured)

Case membership (7 compared, 0 excluded) is listed per row in the app's "Show compared / excluded cases" view and can be re-derived from the full results export.

## Full run, measured

| | Jev | LLM judge |
|---|---|---|
| Calls | 7 of 7 rows (one per row, all metrics) | 21 (one per metric) |
| Metric scores returned | 21 (+7 not applicable) | 21 (+7 not applicable, no call) |
| Time per call, median / p95 | 305 ms / 345 ms (covers every metric of the row) | 8.43 s / 8.94 s (one metric) |
| Time per row, median | 305 ms (same single call) | 25.35 s (sum of per-metric calls over 7 rows) |
| Estimated cost, whole run | $0.00033 | $0.035 |
| Projected cost | $0.047 per 1,000 rows | $1.668 per 1,000 metric calls |

Whole-run totals use different units (Jev per row, LLM judge per metric call), so they are not divided into a ratio; the only ratio is the same-workload one above.

Pricing recorded at run start (estimate = recorded tokens × list price, not an invoice): Jev $0.042 per 1M input tokens (output free); LLM judge $0.75 in / $4.5 out per 1M tokens.

## Agreement with dataset labels

| Metric | Jev ↔ labels | LLM judge ↔ labels | Jev ↔ LLM judge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intent resolution | 71.4% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.38 (n = 7 score pairs) | 85.7% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.29 (n = 7 score pairs) | 57.1% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.42 (n = 7 score pairs) |
| Task adherence | 100.0% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.33 (n = 7 score pairs) | 71.4% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.57 (n = 7 score pairs) | 71.4% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.46 (n = 7 score pairs) |
| Tool call accuracy | no comparable pairs (n = 0) | no comparable pairs (n = 0) | no comparable pairs (n = 0) |
| Groundedness | 100.0% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.16 (n = 7 score pairs) | 100.0% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.57 (n = 7 score pairs) | 100.0% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.52 (n = 7 score pairs) |
| All metrics | 90.5% pass/fail agreement, MAE 0.29 (n = 21 score pairs) | 85.7% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.14 (n = 21 score pairs) | 76.2% pass/fail agreement, MAE 1.13 (n = 21 score pairs) |

n counts metric score pairs where both sides have a numeric score; unlabelled, not-applicable and failed scores are left out, not counted as 0.

## Limitations

- Labels are the ones in this dataset. For the bundled samples they are synthetic labels written by the dataset author, not an independent human study.
- One run on one dataset. No confidence interval is given; this is not a general performance claim for either judge.
- Costs are estimates from recorded tokens and list prices. Missing cost or time is reported as unknown and excluded from like-for-like figures.
- LLM judge per-row time is a sum of per-metric call times, not measured wall time. Jev time is one call per row.
- Cost and speed say nothing about accuracy; read agreement separately with its own n.

## Full evidence

This brief contains no trace text, prompts or keys. For row-level evidence use the app's Export step: Results (JSONL/CSV, every row and metric of this run), Benchmark summary (JSON) and Dataset (JSONL/CSV; note it holds the current dataset, which may include edits made after this run).
